title: HIPAA Breach Notification Recipient Graph
tagline: One disclosure can create several notices, but none of them exists merely because a draft was approved internally.

cards: One incident suggests one universal breach notice.
Role, count, place, and contact branch
Each fact changes recipients and delivery paths.
People, HHS, media, or the covered entity silently disappear.
The privacy officer owns the decision and every receipt stays truthful.

story.headline: The breach notice sent to everyone except the responsible entity
beats: A business associate discovers an exposure involving hundreds of records.
Its first federal duty runs to the covered entity, whose recipient graph differs.
The agent transfers a covered-entity template and marks every notice delivered.
The graph preserves actor, population, geography, contact path, and actual receipts.
